scope: Isolated geography oracle plus existing APK02 nominal release/LAND. No new runtime by QA.
geography: Origin binds exact run/epoch/boot/operator/generation and closed native external anchor, specific explicit post-arm confirmation row and raw AP Home. A matching checksum on an unbound arbitrary file is insufficient.
Use every actual armed observation through terminal disarm; reject re-arming after terminal disarm, empty/unfinished windows, missing samples or changed context. No best safe subwindow selection.
Keep pre-authority startup coordinates and label them, including 0,0. Legitimate confirmed Home 0,0 is valid for the oracle when current GPS/EKF/Home qualify.
Any armed geographic jump, including 0,0 from another Home, remains in the window and fails the unchanged 10m limit. Relative altitude remains at most 5m.

Latest preceding GPS/EKF/Home/HB must qualify and remain fresh for each armed position. A newer bad or unknown fact overrides older good facts. Duplicate/reordered/foreign or boot-reset bytes cannot refresh qualification.
After confirmation, any changed Home or datum/context mismatch fails. Native confirmation cannot precede actual armed/post-arm Home observations.
Strict finite WGS84 lat/lon, E7/mm integer types, domains, missing values and declared datum. Boolean-as-integer and strings fail. No blanket rejection of geographic 0,0.
Dateline wrap and polar coordinates tested against independent WGS84 ECEF chord for short distances; long distances need only fail the 10m bound without wrap artifacts.
Ground-only no-consent recovery does not need a post-arm confirmation and cannot produce a flight pass.
Old loss05 may receive a new versioned result, while its original CONTROL_NOT_READY receipt stays immutable. This cannot be represented as historical acceptance.
nominal: UP revokes user consent before one BRAKE17 safety intent.
A fresh actual AP mode17 observation precedes neutral and release. ACK alone is insufficient.
No normal RC after revocation, no consent while WAIT_HOLD and no automatic grant from neutral sampling.
Fresh centered unheld sample plus a second explicit operator action produces a different lease ID.
User LAND9 requires completed release and new fresh consent; root observes LAND/ground/disarm independently of ACK or forced stop.
No GCS-failsafe or error confounder for the explicit nominal LAND scenario.
retainedGaps: Existing immutable native Flight02 rejects Home0,0; new oracle support is not global native product support.
Kernel/remote network age and physical HID remain unmeasured.
30-minute, full cockpit/media, real Hera/HeraHub/payload and production remain separate.
